title: Product listing skips the first page
issue: GET /products?page=1 never shows the first 10 products. Customers see products 11-20 on page 1, and the last products are unreachable.

title: Product search is SQL-injectable and breaks on apostrophes
issue: Searching for O'Brien crashes the search endpoint with a SQL error, and a pentester reports that searching for ' OR '1'='1 dumps the whole products table.

title: Customers see other customers' cart items
issue: When a new customer adds their first item, their cart already contains items another customer added earlier. Carts appear to be shared between sessions.

title: Checkout with any coupon crashes with TypeError
issue: Applying coupon WELCOME10 at checkout raises TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Every coupon is broken in production.

title: Any user can cancel anyone else's order
issue: Security report: user Bob was able to cancel Alice's order by calling the cancel endpoint with her order id. Only the order owner or an admin should be allowed to cancel; others must get PermissionDenied.

title: Inventory goes negative
issue: We sold 6 units of a product that only had 5 in stock; stock is now -1. Reserving more stock than available should raise OutOfStock and leave stock unchanged.

title: Unknown product returns HTTP 200
issue: GET /products/999 for a product that does not exist returns status 200 with an error body. Clients and caches treat it as success. It should return 404.
